b1bb506d.name: Stephanie Tess Manrique
b1bb506d.their_message: And then we can see if it makes sense to set up a meeting, sorry I am getting loads of these messages every week.
b1bb506d.proposed_reply:
Hey Stephanie, totally get it and no need to apologize at all! 😊

So the honest answer is it really depends on your specific situation. Where you're at, who your ideal client is, what's worked before and what hasn't. Without knowing that I'd just be giving you a generic answer and that's exactly what I don't want to do.

What I can tell you is that everything we do is completely personalised. No templates, no mass outreach. Real research, real conversations tailored to the right people for your business specifically.

To give you anything actually useful I'd need to ask you a few questions first if that's okay? 

Starting with the basics... what kind of coaching do you do? 😊
